tL.text: The rest of the layout (drawn with lens 1)

sK.text:
Same moment in all five: fighting, 2 unread.

Top to bottom: the closed pane strip (a thin lip to pull), the fight card right under it, then the game text. The map is a round lens with a glass shine; tap it to step between three zoom levels. Chat key top right with an unread count; no message cards.

Bottom: the compass now starts at the bottom edge (U, D and F as letters), the command field is narrower, and the history key is gone.

sL.text:
Pane strip: pulled from the top, swipe sideways to change pane (dots, no tabs). The fight card rides along just under it.

Comm: opens under the fight card from the chat key; drag its lower edge to resize.

Menu: Reconnect, Profile, Scripts, Settings, text size, Black / Paper. Statistics is a pane in the strip, not in the menu.
